warnings: Electrical specification notes. Cable sizes are given by circuit type: lighting sub-circuits 2x2.5 VAF, switch drops and luminaire-to-luminaire 2x1.5 VAF, socket circuits 2x2.5/G1.5 VAF-GRD, feeders 'ขนาดตามแบบ' (per drawing).
Referenced Thai standards: มอก.236-2533 (fluorescent tubes), มอก.344-2530 (lampholders/starter holders), มอก.183-2528 (starters), มอก.23-2521 (ballasts), มอก.11-2531 (cable).
Approved manufacturer lists are transcribed verbatim, including the spelling 'HANGER' used on the sheet.
